mediaWork.title: Duped: Why Innocent People Confess — and Why We Believe Their Confessions
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Analysis of false confessions, why innocent people confess to crimes they didn't commit, and why others believe these false confessions
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This book examines the psychological mechanisms behind false confessions, exploring how police interrogation techniques, psychological pressure, and manipulation lead innocent individuals to confess.  It also analyzes why these confessions are often believed despite contradictory evidence, and connects false confessions to wrongful convictions.  The book offers science-based recommendations for reducing false confessions.
